$comment: MCP servers this plugin can make use of. NONE of these are required: every capability
resolves through engine/capability-registry, which degrades honestly when a provider is
absent. Remove any entry you do not want; the system reports the affected test
categories as BLOCKED rather than pretending to cover them.
Playwright MCP tool names were verified against github.com/microsoft/playwright-mcp.
MCP servers move quickly -- re-verify before relying on a specific tool name, and never

playwright.$note: --isolated keeps the browser profile in memory so a test session never inherits or pollutes real browser state. --output-dir puts screenshots and traces somewhere they can be registered as evidence.

$disabled_examples.$comment: Move an entry into mcpServers to enable it. Left disabled by default because each needs credentials the user must supply deliberately.

github.$note: The official GitHub MCP server usually requires an OAuth flow. When it is unavailable, the capability registry falls back to the `gh` CLI if that is authenticated — check `gh auth status` and its token scopes.

atlassian.$note: Atlassian (Jira/Confluence) connector. Requires authorisation in an interactive session. Without it, jira.* capabilities resolve to the JIRA_BASE_URL/JIRA_EMAIL/JIRA_API_TOKEN REST fallback, or report unavailable.
